findings.text: The schema's inline f0_binding.consistency_evidence_sha256 (675a99d0d25b) no longer resolves on disk: the live artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json measures 9e335e9ba1bf and FROZEN rev28 pins that newer value. The class bytes are unaffected and the declared F0 taxonomy hash still matches, but any citation of the inline evidence pointer must use the rev28 pin instead. This is the same defect independently recorded as HF-086-R1 in reviews/G-FORM-rev12-binding-086.json; it is excluded from this accept's scope rather than re-litigated.

HF-034-F2A-1 (ill-typed D0 / disjunctive binder) is closed at rev12: D0 is a tagged disjoint union over r with the smooth branch no longer typed as a pair, ordered[0] is forall r over D0, and the D0 definition string is byte-identical across F1, F2a and F2b (C09).

HF-034-F2A-2 (class_contract_pointer resolving only in the authoring tree) is closed at rev12: class_contract_pointer targets research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml#classes.AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN and resolves, while the supplement lives in the separate class_contract_supplement_pointer field pointing at artifacts/formulation/formulation_taxonomy.yaml#class_contracts.AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN (C04, C05).

The licensed C0=>C2 transfer precondition now holds at the frozen data class: F2a and F2b share the same (s>5/2, delta in (1/2,1)) regularity signature, the ledger carries C0=>C2 and H2_loc=>C2 entailments, and C2=>C0 remains forbidden (C15).

Class separation is clean: conclusion_type scc_c2_future_inextendibility, one_class_only = AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN, merge_forbidden true, anti_scope names the C0/WCC neighbours, no stray non-frozen class token appears in the file, and no WCC/I+ predicate leaks into the conclusion (C08, C11, C12).

Publication binding verified at the FROZEN rev28 pin: canonical and authoring bytes are equal, both FROZEN paths carry the same sha256, frozen_at is not future-dated, no duplicate top-level YAML keys, and revised_at is wall-clock consistent (C01, C02, C07).

scope: Independent machine-checked structural and consistency review of F2a revision 12 at the FROZEN rev28 pin: closure of HF-034-F2A-1/HF-034-F2A-2, D0 well-typedness and cross-class identity, the licensed C0=>C2 transfer precondition, class-identity/merge separation, and frozen-pin/mirror alignment. Excludes: adjudication of the inline consistency-evidence pointer drift (OBS-089-1, already tracked as HF-086-R1), the O-GFORM-1 F2a/F2b data_class-differentiation objection, L1 citation adjudication, and any gate verdict.
independence: worker-089 authored no canonical artifact and no part of F2a, and has never reviewed F2a; its prior tasks bound F2b and the F0-dependency evidence only. The checker carries ten planted-defect controls (M1-M10) plus the unmutated no-false-positive baseline, so the pass is controlled rather than asserted.
next_falsifier: Any of checks C01-C15 flips to fail at a newer canonical hash of schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml, or the FROZEN pin/mirror equality breaks, or any planted control stops being caught: this accept is then void for the newer revision. A hash move inside the stability window would make the verdict advisory for the pinned bytes only (the 90 s window showed no drift).
